contained,thepartiesheretocovenantandagreeasfollows: Article 1 DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTRESTRICTIONS The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith,executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (herein called the “Declaration"), a copy of which is annexed hereto as Exhibit C and made a part hereof, which seeks to effectuate theintentions of the Owner and Developer to create the singleZoning Lot Lot"). Article2 DEVELOPMENT RIGHTS Section 2.1.Owner hereby transfers and conveys toDeveloper theExcess Development Rights, consents to Developer's incorporation of the same into Developer's Building and toDeveloper's utilization of theExcessDevelopmentRights todevelop Developer's Parcel, and agrees that (a) no new building or other new improvement on Owner's Parcel shall utilize the Excess Development Rights and (b) except in the event of damage or destruction to Owner's Parcel and Developer's Parcel, there will not be any change in the existing use of Owner's Building or amendment or application to amend the Certificate of Occupancy for Owner's Building that will utilize the Excess Development Rights or that alters the zoning calculations for the Building in such a way as to effectively make the Excess Development Rights unavailable for Developer. Owner shall retain all rights in and to Owner's Parcel, the 9,600 square feet of Floor Area currently used by Owner's Building ("Owner's Floor Area"), including but not limited to the right to construct improvements and other structures on its Parcel and existing Building, subject, however to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement. Section 2.2. Notice is hereby given that this transfer restricts Owner and Owner's Parcel to the use of Owner's Floor Area, subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein. Section 2.3.For the purposes of thisAgreement: (a)“Bonus Rights" shall mean available bonus Floor Area approved by the applicable agency or agencies of the City of New York (the “Agencies") from time to time in connectionwith theSingle Zoning Lot. from any upward revision by the Agencies of the allowable Floor Area applicable to the Single Zoning Lot, by amendment of the ZoningResolution or by any other means.
